What's new in 2.1.12

  • Adds automatic import profiles for Pickles, Thunderdome, Cass Base, Shaala DJ, and Yue & Lu's DJ.
  • Routes animation, VFX, and audio imports using each detected mod's existing replacement paths.
  • Improves YouTube and SoundCloud downloads by using the bundled FFmpeg and accepting current SoundCloud sign-in cookies.

For full details see the release page: https://github.com/ShaalaXIV/STAGE/releases
